name: Skreech Verminking
canonNotes: The greatest Verminlord, created when the Horned Rat released and fused the imprisoned Council of Thirteen into one daemon.
Holds the skills of every Skaven clan and has vowed to spread corruption in the Horned Rat's name.
voiceNotes: Vast, many-voiced and contemptuous; the Rat King speaking to lesser beings.
Schemes on a divine scale; mortals are pawns.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
